universal_lens: A conformal invariant framework unifies client-side function extraction and JSON endpoint capture through arithmetic operand filtering and domain-specific symbolic logic. The structural unification of discrete digital endpoints manifests as a high-dimensional adjacency matrix. Each fantasy or sportsbook host represents a node in a global information manifold, where the integer counts of JSON payloads and callable functions define the local curvature of available market liquidity.
gsi_mapping: Bayesian inference maps filtered client functions to probabilistic player projections using arithmetic kernels and domain lexicons embedded in function bodies. GSI maps these endpoint inventories into a Bayesian hierarchical model. The observed function counts serve as priors for platform-specific data richness. Conformal prediction intervals are constructed around the expected yield of proprietary signals, ensuring rigorous coverage over the heterogeneous distribution of public versus server-side API availability.
gse_mapping: Situational reasoning in GSE models host-state transitions via UI handler exclusion and arithmetic operation detection in minified JS bundles. Within GSE, this registry dictates the situational state-transition graph. The engine dynamically allocates computational resources to scrape or query active hosts based on their functional depth. A higher function count implies a richer state-space for simulating real-time roster adjustments and dynamic market reactions.
